+
+Use Cloudflare Containers for pinned Hermes `0.21.5` (upstream commit `f97608f178d1ffeca59860195ab7da295f7c8e5f`), Python, Browser Use and local Chromium. A Worker controls lifecycle and protected access; ordinary Workers alone do not provide this Linux runtime.
+
+Container disk is ephemeral. Before deployment, implement and test durable profile/auth/history/browser-state storage outside it, restore before gateway start, and checkpoint safely across restart. Cloudflare recommends external storage and supports lifecycle coordination through Durable Objects. A continuously connected Slack Socket Mode gateway also needs supervised restart and an explicitly costed running-container lifecycle; scale-to-zero cannot receive Slack Socket Mode events while stopped.
+
+Docs: https://developers.cloudflare.com/containers/ and https://developers.cloudflare.com/containers/faq/.
+
+## Prepared owner-only baseline
+
+`hermes-owner.yaml` restricts the bot to the existing owner's DM and disables multiplexing and tools.
